notes.title: Version 1.2.9 Adds Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese Support!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10847188/33aa31422e842f64221cfbf6a6adab24212b820b.png
Version 1.2.9 for Sora is now live, adding support two new languages - Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese!

We hope that with this update, even more players can experience the wonderful story of Sora.

Sora is also -50% off this week in the Fruitbat Factory publisher sale!

notes.title: Version 1.2.8 Now Live!
notes.notes:
Version 1.2.8. Now Live!
Replays will now play in the language they were recorded with.
For versions older than 1.2.7, English language is used.
For version 1.2.7, please view replay in the language it was recorded in to ensure correct playback.
Fixed a crash when launching the game without Steam active.
